file_insights.changes_summary: Enhanced movement modal with comprehensive accessibility features
key_modifications: Added ARIA attributes (role, aria-modal, aria-labelledby, aria-label)
Implemented focus trap mechanism for keyboard navigation
Added focus management to trap Tab key within modal
Separated modal backdrop into independent element
Implemented focus restoration when modal closes
Added Alpine.js transitions with x-transition directives
Changed from conditional class binding to x-show directive
Added modal-dialog-centered class for centered positioning

patterns_discovered.description: Keyboard event handler captures Tab key and cycles focus between first and last focusable elements within modal
patterns_discovered.reusability: High - can be extracted to Alpine.js component

patterns_discovered.description: Stores reference to previously focused element before opening modal, then restores focus when modal closes
patterns_discovered.benefit: Improves user experience by returning to context after modal dismissal

patterns_discovered.description: Backdrop moved from separate Alpine component to managed element within modal for unified state management
patterns_discovered.benefit: Single source of truth for modal open/close state

patterns_discovered.description: Uses role='dialog', aria-modal='true', aria-labelledby to establish proper modal semantics
Alpine.js x-transition directives for smooth enter/leave with opacity and scale transforms
patterns_discovered.benefit: Visually smooth state changes without breaking accessibility

gotchas_discovered.description: Inline @keydown.tab handler is lengthy and could be difficult to maintain. Focus trap logic duplicated in both template and JavaScript.
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Could be extracted to a custom Alpine.js directive or utility function

gotchas_discovered.description: Selector 'button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])' may not capture all interactive elements (e.g., contenteditable, custom components)
gotchas_discovered.context: Used in both template and JavaScript init method

gotchas_discovered.description: Focus management uses $nextTick() which may race with Alpine's transition animations. Timing could cause focus visible indicator to appear during animation.
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Could coordinate with transition-end events or use explicit delay

gotchas_discovered.description: Both @keydown.escape.window and @click.outside close the modal. Multiple paths to same action could cause state synchronization issues.
gotchas_discovered.note: Currently working but increases cognitive load

approach_outcome.summary: Successfully transformed movement modal from basic Bootstrap implementation to fully accessible WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliant modal dialog
key_achievements: Implemented focus trap preventing keyboard users from tabbing out of modal
Added proper ARIA semantics for screen readers
Restored focus to trigger element on modal close
Maintained visual design with smooth transitions
Unified modal state management by removing duplicate backdrop component
approach_outcome.accessibility_coverage: Focus management, keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, semantic HTML

recommendations.recommendation: Extract focus trap logic into a reusable Alpine.js directive (e.g., x-trap-focus) to reduce duplication and improve maintainability
recommendations.rationale: Focus trap appears in both template and init method; directive pattern would be DRY and testable

recommendations.recommendation: Add automated accessibility tests for focus trap, ARIA attributes, and focus restoration using tools like Playwright with axe-core
recommendations.rationale: Accessibility improvements are easy to regress; automated tests prevent future breakage

recommendations.recommendation: Create a component-based modal system with Alpine.js to standardize accessibility patterns across all modals in the application
recommendations.rationale: Current implementation is modal-specific; refactoring into reusable component prevents copy-paste errors in other modals

recommendations.recommendation: Cache focusable elements selector query instead of running querySelectorAll on every Tab press
recommendations.rationale: Keyboard events fire frequently; caching would improve performance, especially in forms with many fields

recommendations.recommendation: Document the focus trap mechanism and keyboard navigation behavior in code comments or modal component documentation
recommendations.rationale: Complex keyboard handling should be explained for future maintainers
